items.performers: Victoria de los Ángeles, Nicolai Gedda, Janine Micheau, Ernest Blanc; French Radio chorus and orchestra; Thomas Beecham
items.label: EMI / Warner Classics
items.note: The two acoustic arias in the Hall introduce Carmen and Escamillo separately. The complete opera supplies José’s Flower Song, the cards and the final duet, in which the refrain of the bullring crowd is heard during the murder scene. Beecham’s set is the first choice.

items.work: Les Pêcheurs de perles — complete opera
items.performers: Nicolai Gedda; Opéra-Comique chorus and orchestra; Pierre Dervaux
items.label: EMI / Warner Classics
items.note: Nadir’s romance and the conflict around Leïla are heard only in the complete work, beyond the friendship duet. Dervaux’s recording, with Gedda, is an introduction to Bizet’s earlier theatre. Warner’s page identifies it as the complete performance, not a highlights compilation.
